question: How many edits were made to the Wikipedia page on Antidisestablishmentarianism from its inception until June of 2023?

history.content:

1) Verify page inception date via the article’s metadata.
2) Use either MediaWiki API or trusted tools (XTools Page History) to obtain edit counts by year/month.
3) Sum edits from 2001–2022 and add Jan–Jun 2023.
4) Cross-check with revision history filters by date as a fallback.

history.name: Orchestrator

history.name: Assistant
